question: Are the three missing closed35 court files legitimately accepted dependencies of the canonical 55-test R7 gate that should be restored to control, or should the R7 gate be rebased?

independently_measured_denominator.method: ran pytest --collect-only in the GOVERNED R7 interpreter on the candidate tree, plus per-file collection
independently_measured_denominator.hard_evidence: invoking pytest with all six paths aborts with 'ERROR: file or directory not found' and 'no tests collected' (exit 4) - the missing files are not a collection shortfall, they are absent paths

lineage_finding.divergence: the two lineages DIVERGED at 87029d349. The accepted R9 tip is NOT an ancestor of the control base, and the accepted runtime deea4054 is NOT an ancestor of control either.

authoritative_definitions.content: schema PYAT_C4C3_AUTHORITATIVE_C3_COURT@1.0.0, phase 'authoritative C3 six-file court', REQUIRED_RESULT '55 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped', MEETS_REQUIREMENT true, execution tree 8f7efe690a161902e79358eb31650c238a4c0be8, interpreter /var/folders/.../T/opencode/c4c3-env/bin/python
this reviewer ran exactly these six files in the governed R7 venv and recorded 55 collected then 55/55 twice

adoption_status_of_the_R7_gate.lineage_of_the_gate: 1df64cc59 is on the ACCEPTED lineage and is NOT an ancestor of control. The gate's 55-test denominator is therefore anchored to the accepted C4C3 tree, where all six files and their production modules coexist.
adoption_status_of_the_R7_gate.is_the_gate_binding_on_a_CONTROL_fan_in_: NO - and this is the decisive point. The 55-test denominator is a property of the ACCEPTED tree, not a universal invariant of the repository. Imposing it on control imports a requirement from a lineage that control never carried.

why_RESTORE_is_not_lawful_or_sufficient.restoring_court_files_alone_is_IMPOSSIBL: the three court files are not self-contained. test_closed35_g01_sav_numeric_representation_authority.py imports `rawlsing_next.closed35_g01_sav_numeric_representation_authority`, a PRODUCTION module that DOES NOT EXIST ON CONTROL AT ALL (verified: git ls-tree control -> 0 matches; accepted -> 1 match).
why_RESTORE_is_not_lawful_or_sufficient.therefore: restoring the courts would require ALSO restoring accepted-lineage PRODUCTION modules (at minimum closed35_g01_sav_numeric_representation_authority.py, and it would pull on the divergent decoder and codec blobs). That is no longer a court restore; it is a production backport of accepted C3 semantics into control - a materially different and larger act than the fan-in performed, and one this lane is forbidden to perform (commission: 'Do NOT repair code'; 'No code changes').
why_RESTORE_is_not_lawful_or_sufficient.control_production_blobs_already_differ: control's decoder (d2a074a41fb5) and codec (72f8f3c03ed0) are the PRE-C3 bytes; the accepted lineage carries the C3-accepted decoder (b406d45fae41) and codec (6000a1704d71). The candidate already ports the accepted decoder, which is precisely why the SR06 tests break (see 02).

what_control_actually_carries_instead.control_court_spec: .rabochii/court_spec.json @ 0e8d5bcd defines its OWN sanctioned court set: semantic_candidate_sha 5726648a5fa9de5bbdf67d653f921d59d9cb1a70, six different test files (test_fiabc_lits_parity_ready_checkpoint_v2, test_fiabc_lits_cross_schema_candidate_identity, test_fiabc_lits_astra_substantive_parity, test_fiabc_final_oracle_freeze_producers, test_pre553_independent_parity_oracle, test_fiabc_lits_i_i03_operation_autho...), determinism_mode EXACT, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1
what_control_actually_carries_instead.significance: control has its own governed court definition. It does not list any of the six R7 files. The 55-test R7 gate is not control's court.

reasoning: the 55-test denominator is anchored to the accepted C4C3 tree (1df64cc59, on the accepted lineage only, not an ancestor of control)
the three absent files are TEST files for accepted-C3 PRODUCTION modules that control never carried; one dependency module is wholly absent from control
restoring the tests alone cannot work; restoring tests+production is a C3 backport the commission forbids in this lane
control has its own sanctioned court set that excludes all six R7 files
therefore the honest resolution is to rebase the gate to control's court set, and to record the accepted-lineage 55/55 result as an ACCEPTED-LINEAGE qualification, not a control-lineage obligation
choice.not_chosen_RESTORE: rejected because it is impossible at court-file grain and out of scope at production grain
choice.not_chosen_MATERIAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT: no two authorities contradict each other. The apparent conflict dissolves once the gate is attributed to the lineage that actually defines it.

correction_to_the_fanin_candidates_frami: the candidate describes the three files as living on 'a separate accepted lineage' - accurate - but then treats the 55-test gate as an obligation of the CONTROL fan-in. The sharper finding is that the gate is a property of the accepted lineage, so its unsatisfiability on control is a GATE-ATTRIBUTION error, not a missing-dependency defect.
